stumbles.quote: The two judges labelled 58 of those 63 as legitimate prose
stumbles.why: The text never says who or what "the two judges" are (people, models, a test harness). "Legitimate" is also unexplained: it seems to mean not a real violation.

stumbles.quote: because the cells held numbers and labels rather than sentences
stumbles.why: This conflicts with calling the cells "legitimate prose". The cells are said to be numbers and labels, not sentences, so they are not prose at all.
The text never says what counts as a hit, meaning which patterns the linter flags. That makes it hard to see why table cells would trigger it.

point: The PR adds a `--skip-tables` flag that blanks only lines starting with `|`, so the linter ignores Markdown tables, which produced many false positives, while italics and blockquotes are still scanned.
